semiconductor_relevance: High — SICREAT is a leading distributor of silicon wafers and provides wafer services specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: SICREAT (Suzhou) Semitech Co., Ltd specializes in the distribution of silicon wafers and offers comprehensive wafer services, including processes from bare silicon to thermal oxide. Their product offerings include various types of wafers such as Dummy, Spacer, and Test Wafers, catering to the needs of the semiconductor manufacturing sector.
capabilities: Wafer services including Dummy, Spacer, and Test Wafers

regional_presence.China: SICREAT is based in Suzhou, China, focusing on the semiconductor market.
